description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Planar Gate.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat from step 3.
